reason: AutoEvo primarily orchestrates an agent workflow for discovering, reviewing, installing, verifying, upgrading, or creating DSH capabilities with approval and controlled execution boundaries.

summaries.zh: AutoEvo 为 DSH Agent 编排能力发现、审查、复用、安装、验证、升级及受控创建流程。
summaries.en: AutoEvo orchestrates DSH agent workflows for discovering, reviewing, reusing, installing, verifying, upgrading, and creating capabilities under controlled approvals.

capabilities: Discovers and searches reusable local or community DSH plugins and skills
Reviews candidate manifests, documentation, and selected source evidence
Installs or removes plugins with approval and immutable package specifications
Modifies partially matching plugins or creates new hosted git sources in controlled workflows
Verifies loader and runtime installation results
